_why_break_window_seconds: Coordinator-approved tune (Lane channel #356, 2026-09-27; BOSSES §3). On the built deck one solo lap of the four conduits is ~140 m, not the 120 m BOSSES assumed: it walks round the sealed Waterward gate 4 m in front of conduit 1, the Crown stair foot beside conduit 0 and the fenced ascent band. At 5.6 m/s the live piloted lap (tests/smoke_stormwood_marrow_press.gd) finished inside 30 s on about half the runs, 0.3-3 s either side. 36 s restores the spec's ~7 s margin on the real geometry.
